item.title: Disease tied to excrement on the rise in Broome County
item.description: BINGHAMTON, N.Y. (WIVT/WBGH) - Local health officials are sounding the alarm after seeing a significant spike in a highly contagious gastrointestinal illness. Broome County Health Department (BCHD) announced on Thursday that it has observed an increase in shigellosis cases, a gastrointestinal illness that is caused by the bacteria Shigella.
